headline: Revenue climbs, quarterly profit softens, EPS grows y/y
summary_short: Domino's reported Q2 FY2026 revenue of $1,194M, up 3.8% q/q and 4.3% y/y, while diluted EPS of $4.07 fell 1.5% q/q but rose 6.8% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of $1,194M rose 3.8% q/q and 4.3% y/y. Gross margin was 40.0% of revenue, down roughly 34bp q/q and 22bp y/y. Operating income of $232M rose 0.7% q/q and 3.1% y/y; EBITDA of $242M fell 2.3% q/q but rose 3.6% y/y. Net income of $136M fell 2.9% q/q while rising 3.6% y/y. Diluted EPS of $4.07 fell 1.5% q/q but rose 6.8% y/y; weighted diluted shares outstanding fell to 33.3M, down 1.5% q/q and 3.1% y/y. No cash-position figure is carried on the shard for this period.
